title: Toxocara and Giardia antibodies
what: This blood test looks for antibodies to two parasites: Toxocara, which comes from dogs and cats, and Giardia, which lives in the bowel.
why: For skin rash and itching, a cough with no clear cause, belly pain, diarrhea, or high eosinophils, a type of white blood cell, in a blood test.
duration: the blood draw takes a few minutes; results usually come in 1 to 5 days
tell_doctor: If you have a dog or cat at home
If your child plays in a sandbox or puts hands in the mouth
If you were already treated for parasites

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: You usually do not need to fast strictly, but it is better to come 3 to 4 hours after a light, non-fatty meal. Check with the lab.

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Do not stop anything on your own. Tell your doctor what you take. They will decide if anything needs to change before the test.

prepare.title: Your child
prepare.text: If a child is being tested, tell them there will be a quick prick. Bring water and a snack for afterward.

prepare.title: Clothing
prepare.text: A sleeve you can easily roll up above the elbow.

bring: Your referral or list of tests
Your complete blood count and stool test, if you had them
steps: You sit down and rest your arm on the armrest
A band is tied above your elbow, and you are asked to clench your fist a few times
The skin is wiped with antiseptic
A quick prick. Blood fills the tubes in a few seconds
The needle comes out, and a cotton pad is pressed on the spot
feel: A quick prick, like a pinch
Sometimes slight dizziness. Tell the nurse, and they will help you lie down
A child may be scared. Stay close
after: Press the cotton pad for 3 to 5 minutes
For Giardia, the doctor often also orders a stool test
Do not give a child worm medicine unless a doctor prescribed it
red_flags: The puncture site is very swollen, painful, and red

faq.q: Why is a stool test also needed for Giardia?
faq.a: Antibodies can stay after the illness is over. A stool test shows more accurately whether the parasite is there now.

faq.q: Can I take worm pills just in case?
faq.a: Better not. A doctor prescribes treatment based on test results.

reminders.text: Toxocara and Giardia antibody test tomorrow. Better to skip fatty food in the morning.
